messages.content: Hey Jon! Good to see you. What's up? Anything new?
Hey Gina! Good to see you too. Lost my job as a banker yesterday, so I'm gonna take a shot at starting my own business.
Sorry about your job Jon, but starting your own business sounds awesome! Unfortunately, I also lost my job at Door Dash this month. What business are you thinking of?
Sorry to hear that! I'm starting a dance studio 'cause I'm passionate about dancing and it'd be great to share it with others.
That's cool, Jon! What got you into this biz?
I've been into dancing since I was a kid and it's been my passion and escape. I wanna start a dance studio so I can teach others the joy that dancing brings me.
Wow Jon, same here! Dance is pretty much my go-to for stress relief. Got any fave styles?
Cool, Gina! I love all dances, but contemporary is my top pick. It's so expressive and powerful! What's your fave?
Yeah, me too! Contemporary dance is so expressive and graceful - it really speaks to me.
Wow, great idea! Let's go to a dance class, it'll be so much fun!
Yeah! Let's explore some new dance moves. We should plan a dance session soon!
Yeah definitely! Wanna see my moves next Fri? Can't wait!
Sounds great, Jon! Next Friday works. Let's boogie!
Wow, I'm excited too! This is gonna be great! (image description: a photography of a man in a suit is performing a dance)
Wow! What did you get?

Woah, that pic's from when my dance crew took home first in a local comp last year. It was amazing up on that stage! I'm super keen to spread that intensity with other peeps. Gina, you ever been in any dance comps or shows?

I used to compete in a few dance competitions and shows - my fav memory was when my team won first place at a regionals at age fifteen. It was an awesome feeling of accomplishment! (image description: a photography of a couple of people standing next to each other)
Wow! Winning first place is amazing! What dance were you doing?
Thanks! We just did a contemporary piece called "Finding Freedom." It was really emotional and powerful. (image description: a photo of a large open porch with a fireplace and a view of the water)
Wow, that must've been great! Check my ideal dance studio by the water. (image description: a photography of a room with a view of the ocean and a few yoga mats)
Cool setup! Man, you can't deny that view! Got time to rehearse with a biz and a new store?
Hopefully, we will find a place like this that will inspire us!
Wow, it looks great! What dances do you practice? Got any projects planned?

Thanks! I rehearsed with a small group of dancers after work. We do all kinds of dances, from contemporary to hip-hop. We've got some cool projects in the works. Finishing up choreography to perform at a nearby festival next month. Can't wait! (image description: a photo of a group of dancers in white dresses on a stage)
Wow, it looks awesome! Are they yours at the festival? They're so graceful!
Yeah, they're the ones performing at the festival! They've been practicing hard and will definitely impress with their grace and skill.
Wow, they look great! Can't wait to see them rock the festival. Gonna be awesome!
Yeah, awesome! Glad to be part of it.

Hey Jon! Long time no see! Things have been hectic lately. I just launched an ad campaign for my clothing store in hopes of growing the business. Starting my own store and taking risks is both scary and rewarding. I'm excited to see where it takes me! (image description: a photo of a clothing store with a variety of clothes on display)
Hey Gina! Whoa, your store looks great! All your hard work really paid off - congrats! Must be awesome to see your stuff on display.
Thanks a bunch! It's awesome seeing my vision happen. How's the dance studio going? Did you find the right spot?

Hey Gina! Thanks for asking. I'm on the hunt for the ideal spot for my dance studio and it's been quite a journey! I've been looking at different places and picturing how the space would look. I even found a place with great natural light! Oh, I've been to Paris yesterday! It was sooo cool. (image description: a photo of a bathroom with a blue floor and a pink wall)
Wow, nice spot! Where is it? Got any other features you want to think about before you decide? Paris?! That is really great Jon! Never had a chance to visit it. Been only to Rome once.

It's downtown which is awesome cuz it's easy to get to. Plus the natural light! Gotta check the size & floor quality too. We need a good dance floor with enough bounce for me & my students to dance safely.
Definitely! Dance floors help avoid injuries and make dancing more enjoyable. You thinking about it is great. Any particular type of flooring you like?
Yeah, good flooring's crucial. I'm after Marley flooring, which is what dance studios usually use. It's great 'cause it's grippy but still lets you move, plus it's tough and easy to keep clean.
Sounds great! Marley's perfect; it's got the right amount of grip and movement. Can't wait to see your dance studio done!
Yeah, can't wait to see it done! Looking for the right place and getting everything ready has been a mix of exciting and nerve-wracking, but I'm determined to make it work. It'll be worth it!
Believe in yourself, Jon! The process may be tough, but you got this. Push through and it'll be worth it. Don't forget to take breaks and dance it out when you need to destress!
Glad I have you in my corner! Gotta make time to dance and vent, that's for sure. We'll make it through this - hang in there!
Thanks, Jon! Appreciate your support!
Let's keep going and chase our dreams!
Yeah! We've done so much, and there's nothing but good stuff coming. Let's keep going after our goals and making them happen.
Success is almost here. We got this!
Hey Gina, hope you're doing ok! Still following my passion for dance. It's been bumpy, but I'm determined to make it work. I'm still searching for a place to open my dance studio.

Hi Jon! So happy you're pushing forward with dancing! Inspiring 💪 I emailed some wholesalers and one replied and said yes today! I'm over the moon because now I can expand my clothing store and get closer to my customers. Check it out - here's a pic! (image description: a photography of a shopping mall with a glass entrance and a sign)

Thanks! It took a bit of time but I wanted to make the place look like my own style and make my customers feel cozy. I chose furniture that looks great and is comfy too. The chandelier adds a nice glam feel while matching the style of the store.
Your store looks great - your customers will be so comfy.
Thanks! Making my spot comfortable and inviting for my customers is key. I want 'em to feel like they're in a cool oasis. Just creating an experience that'll make 'em wanna come back.
That's a great goal! Creating a special experience for customers is the key to making them feel welcome and coming back. I think you can create that space you're imagining.
Thanks. Your support means a lot. I'm sure with my hard work and effort, I can make a special shopping experience for my customers. It's tough but I'm up for the challenge!
I'm always here to support you! Go create something awesome with your store. Keep it up!
Thanks, Jon! I'll try my best. You're gonna do great with your dance studio, just keep going and stay positive! We'll get through this!
Thanks! Your words mean a lot. I'm staying positive and pushing forward. We've put our hearts into our dreams and I'm sure we'll make it.
Sure thing, Jon! Stay motivated and keep going. Hard work pays off eventually. We can do this!
Hey Gina! What's up? How's the store going? I gotta tell you about this thing with my biz.
Hey Jon! The store's doing great! It's a wild ride. How's the biz?
Hey Gina! I'm putting in a lot of work on my business even with the obstacles. I'm gonna make it happen!
Wow! You've got drive! Keep it up and you'll definitely make a splash.
Thanks Gina! Your help really means a lot. Sometimes it's hard when things don't go my way, but I'm sure if I keep pushing, I'll reach my dreams!
Understand where you're at, Jon. Setbacks are just opportunities for comebacks. You got the skills, passion, and drive. Plus my full support. Don't give up, buddy!
